name: Other fiscal records of BARMM local governments (BLGF)
note: Each section is one BLGF publication, in pesos unless a field says otherwise. Each unit’s year is a row of values in the order of the section’s "fields". A year left out is a year the LGU reported nothing. Sulu, in BARMM until 2024, is left out; pre-split Maguindanao’s province rows are under "former"; the eight Special Geographic Area towns have no rows. Barangays are not in any of these. Years before 2019 are the ARMM’s, and Cotabato City’s rows before 2019 are from when it was a Region XII city; a town has rows only from the year it reported.

disasterFund.note: The LDRRMF is at least 5% of an LGU’s estimated regular revenue: 70% for mitigation and preparedness, 30% held as a Quick Response Fund. "Appropriated" is the budget the council passed; "spent" is what was paid out. Spending above the appropriation can come from continuing appropriations of earlier years. BLGF’s FY 2021 workbook files BARMM’s LGUs under Region IX and XII; they are read by province. FY 2025 is preliminary.

borrowing.note: A Certificate of Net Debt Service Ceiling and Borrowing Capacity is DOF’s clearance for an LGU to borrow: it states the loan proposed and the most the LGU can afford to service. It is not a loan — whether one was taken shows in finances.json (borrowings). Amounts are converted from the lists’ thousands of pesos. BLGF also publishes lists for 2016–2021, in an older layout not read here yet.
